req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json Content-Type on all /tasks endpoints returning a body.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-025 requires that every /tasks/* endpoint returning a body must respond with Content-Type: application/json. We test: (1) GET /tasks/ list endpoint returns JSON content-type with 2xx status (positive/EP); (2) GET /tasks/{id} single-task endpoint returns JSON content-type (positive/EP); (3) POST /tasks/ create endpoint returns JSON content-type with 201 (positive/STC); (4) PUT /tasks/{id} update endpoint returns JSON content-type (positive/STC); (5) DELETE /tasks/{id} returns 204 with NO body, so content-type assertion is skipped/verified absent (boundary/BVA); (6) GET /tasks/{id} with non-existent id returns 404 with JSON content-type on error body (negative/NEG); (7) GET /tasks/ with boundary skip/limit values returns JSON content-type (boundary/BVA). Each test asserts the exact content-type string 'application/json' to catch mutations that change the header value, and asserts exact status codes to catch comparison-operator mutations.

tests.name: test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type
actions: Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters
expected: Response body is a JSON array of 20 items
trace: R-TASK-025: all /tasks endpoints returning a body must return application/json
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 20

test_get_tasks_list_returns_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_delete_task_returns_no_body_204
expected: No content-type assertion required for empty body
trace: R-TASK-025: DELETE /tasks/{task_id} returns 204 No Content — boundary case where no body is returned, so content-type requirement does not apply
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_task_returns_no_body_204():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.delete("/tasks/6")
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b""
    # Verify the task is gone: subsequent GET returns 404 with JSON content-type
    r2 = client.get("/tasks/6")
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    assert "application/json" in r2.headers["content-type"]

test_delete_task_returns_no_body_204()

tests.name: test_get_tasks_with_boundary_limit_returns_json_content_type
actions: Send GET /tasks/?skip=0&limit=0 (below minimum, expect 422 with JSON)
expected: limit=1: HTTP 200, application/json, array of exactly 1 item
limit=1000: HTTP 200, application/json, array of 20 items
limit=0: HTTP 422, application/json, validation error body

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_tasks_with_boundary_limit_returns_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=1")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in r1.headers["content-type"]
    assert len(r1.json()) == 1
    r2 = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=1000")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in r2.headers["content-type"]
    assert len(r2.json()) == 20
    r3 = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=0")
    assert r3.status_code == 422
    assert "application/json" in r3.headers["content-type"]
    body3 = r3.json()
    assert "detail" in body3

test_get_tasks_with_boundary_limit_returns_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_exact_json_content_type
actions: Verify each response Content-Type is exactly 'application/json'
expected: All four endpoints return Content-Type containing 'application/json'
All four endpoints return 2xx status codes
No endpoint returns text/html or text/plain
trace: R-TASK-025: decision table covering all body-returning /tasks/* endpoints
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_exact_json_content_type():
    client = TestClient(app)
    cases = []
    r_list = client.get("/tasks/")
    cases.append(("GET /tasks/", r_list, 200))
    r_single = client.get("/tasks/2")
    cases.append(("GET /tasks/2", r_single, 200))
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "CT DT test", "completed": False})
    cases.append(("POST /tasks/", r_create, 201))
    r_update = client.put("/tasks/3", json={"completed": False})
    cases.append(("PUT /tasks/3", r_update, 200))
    for name, r, expected_status in cases:
        assert r.status_code == expected_status, f"{name} status {r.status_code} != {expected_status}"
        ct = r.headers["content-type"]
        assert "application/json" in ct, f"{name} content-type '{ct}' missing application/json"
        assert "text/html" not in ct, f"{name} content-type must not be text/html"

test_all_body_returning_endpoints_have_exact_json_content_type()
